positions.label: Zanarkand
tips: HD Remaster asks Standard or Expert Sphere Grid before the first fight — it cannot be changed later. Nothing else here closes.

positions.label: Baaj Temple
tips: The first Al Bhed Primer is on the Al Bhed ship. Baaj itself reopens with the airship for Anima and the Onion Knight.

positions.label: Besaid Island
tips: Take the Destruction Sphere treasure in the Cloister and talk to the girl and the dog for Valefor's second Overdrive. In HD, Dark Valefor camps the village once you are branded traitors.

positions.label: S.S. Liki & Kilika
tips: Learn the Jecht Shot on the S.S. Winno's deck — the pack treats the crossing as the only chance. Kilika's Cloister has a Destruction Sphere treasure too.

positions.label: Luca
tips: The first tournament is scripted into the story. Blitzball prizes (Wakka's Reels, the Jupiter Sigil) are league and tournament rewards from here on.

positions.label: Mi'ihen Highroad
tips: The Mars Crest is at the end of the Oldroad; the highroad stays reachable, so it can wait. Belgemine's first aeon duel is optional practice.

positions.label: Operation Mi'ihen
tips: Nothing closes. Mushroom Rock Road later hosts the Masamune statue and Rikku's God-hand chest.

positions.label: Djose & the Moonflow
tips: Djose's Cloister has a Destruction Sphere treasure. Rikku joins at the Moonflow — her Al Bhed Primers start paying off.

positions.label: Guadosalam
tips: The Venus Crest is in the Farplane — grab it on the first visit even though it never closes.

positions.label: Thunder Plains
tips: The 200-bolt Venus Sigil dodge can wait for the airship; the Kimahri cactuar stones cannot be done yet either. Just pass through.

positions.label: Macalania Temple
tips: Spherimorph drops the first Jecht Sphere. Macalania's Cloister has a Destruction Sphere treasure; the temple stays reachable but HD's Dark Shiva guards it later.

positions.label: Sanubia Desert & Home
tips: Four Al Bhed Primers burn with Home — sweep every room before the story moves. The Mercury Crest is in the Sanubia sandpit.

positions.label: Bevelle
tips: The Via Purifico primer is on the floor of the underwater maze — no second visit. Let Kimahri learn Thrust Kick from the YKT machina while you are inside; HD's Dark Bahamut blocks the temple later.

positions.label: The Calm Lands
tips: The Celestial Mirror chain starts here (Remiem race → the family in Macalania Woods). Buy capture weapons at the Monster Arena; haggle Yojimbo down in the gorge cavern.

positions.label: Mt. Gagazet
tips: The Saturn Crest is on the mountain past the prayer scene. Capture Gagazet's fiends for the Blossom Crown later.

positions.label: Zanarkand Ruins
tips: Climb back up right after the dome's boss for the Sun Crest — in HD, Dark Bahamut guards it afterward. The dome's Destruction Sphere treasure is the last of the six.

positions.label: The Airship — World Opens
tips: Everything is open: airship passwords and coordinates, Anima at Baaj, the Magus Sisters, the seven Celestial weapons with their crests and sigils, the Monster Arena, the Dark Aeons (HD).

positions.label: Inside Sin
tips: The airship still flies you out until the final descent. Finish the arena and the sigils before Braska's Final Aeon.

items.name: Sphere Grid: Standard or Expert
items.location: Prompt before the first battle (HD / International)

options.label: Standard
options.note: Fixed character paths; more nodes overall. The safer first-run choice.

options.label: Expert
options.note: Everyone starts in the middle; fewer nodes, total freedom. For players who already know the grid.

route.why: One prompt, permanent for the whole run

items.notes: Neither is wrong; the pack only records which you took.

items.name: Al Bhed Primers in Home

route.why: Four primers burn with Home — sweep every room before the story moves

items.notes: Living quarters, main corridor and environs. Home is destroyed at the end of this beat; these volumes are gone forever after.

items.name: Al Bhed Primer — Via Purifico

route.why: On the floor of the underwater maze — no second visit

items.notes: Grab it during Yuna's escape section. Bevelle's halls are closed afterward.

items.name: Thrust Kick (Kimahri's Ronso Rage)

route.why: Lancet the walking machina while Bevelle is open

items.notes: The YKT models only walk Bevelle's halls. In HD, Dark Bahamut stands in the temple doorway once the airship flies — the pack closes the window before that.

items.name: All other Al Bhed Primers
items.notes: The rest stay collectible (compilation spheres can copy previously found volumes). Full literacy pays off in Rikku's Home and the Omega Ruins chatter.

items.name: Jecht Shot
items.location: S.S. Winno — the blitzball on deck

route.why: The deck minigame is the one clean chance to learn Tidus' signature shot

items.notes: Hit the prompts as Jecht's taunts appear. Widely listed as re-learnable later by re-boarding the Winno — the pack keeps the crossing as the window until verified.

items.name: Valefor's second Overdrive

route.why: Talk to the dog — in HD, Dark Valefor later makes returning suicidal

items.notes: A girl in the shop and then the dog by the temple yield Energy Blast. In the HD remaster, Dark Valefor camps Besaid's entrance once you're branded traitors.

items.name: Destruction Sphere treasures

route.why: Take each temple's hidden treasure during its first visit

steps: Besaid — Rod of Wisdom
Kilika — Red Armlet
Djose — Magic Sphere
Macalania — Luck Sphere
Bevelle — HP Sphere (only during the story visit)
Zanarkand — Magistral Rod
items.notes: All six are needed for Anima. In HD, Dark Aeons block several return trips — treat each first visit as the only visit.

items.name: Jecht Spheres ×10

route.why: Start the circuit — they unlock Auron's overdrives

items.notes: First one drops from Spherimorph. Besaid, S.S. Liki, Luca stadium, Mi'ihen, Moonflow, Macalania woods and more — a few sit behind HD Dark Aeon territory, so sweep early where possible.

items.name: Yojimbo

route.why: Haggle the mercenary down while you're in the gorge

items.notes: Offer roughly half his ask and counter three times. In HD, Dark Yojimbo lurks on later revisits — finish the cavern in one trip.

items.name: Sun Crest

route.why: Climb back up immediately after the dome's boss — Dark Bahamut guards it later (HD)

items.notes: The chest appears in the boss room right after the fight. Leave the dome without it and the HD remaster puts Dark Bahamut between you and Tidus' ultimate weapon.

items.name: Celestial Mirror

route.why: Chocobo race for the Cloudy Mirror, then the family in the woods upgrades it

steps: Win the Remiem Temple chocobo race for the Cloudy Mirror
Find the lost boy in Macalania Woods and reunite the family
Touch the crystal for the Celestial Mirror
items.notes: The key to every ultimate weapon chest and crest slot.

items.name: Anima

route.why: Dive back to Baaj once the airship flies

items.notes: Seymour's mother waits beneath the ruins where the game nearly drowned you.

items.name: The Magus Sisters
steps: Blossom Crown — capture one of each Mt. Gagazet fiend for the arena owner
Flower Sceptre — beat Belgemine's Bahamut at Remiem
Open the sealed door at Remiem Temple

route.why: The last aeon needs every other one first

items.notes: Three summons that fight on their own terms.

items.name: Caladbolg (Tidus)
steps: Beat the chocobo trainer's race to open the gorge chest
Sun Sigil — 0:00.0 in the Calm Lands balloon race
Power up at the Macalania crystal with the Mirror

route.why: The sigil race is the hardest minigame in the game — start early

items.notes: The crest is the Zanarkand chest; the sigil race is the hard part.

items.name: Nirvana (Yuna)
steps: Capture one of each Calm Lands species for the arena chest
Moon Crest — the cove on Besaid beach (HD: Dark Valefor territory)
Moon Sigil — defeat all of Belgemine's aeons at Remiem
Power up at the Macalania crystal

route.why: Belgemine's aeon gauntlet doubles as Magus Sisters prep

items.notes: Yuna's staff.

items.name: World Champion (Wakka)
steps: Café owner in Luca hands it over once your blitzball standing is high enough
Jupiter Crest — the Aurochs' locker room
Jupiter Sigil — league prize after Attack, Status and Aurochs Reels are learned
Power up at the Macalania crystal

route.why: Hours of blitzball — the sigil is the slowest in the game

items.notes: Requires blitzball standing.

items.name: God-hand (Rikku)
steps: Input GODHAND at the airship console and open the Mushroom Rock chest
Mercury Crest — the Sanubia sandpit
Mercury Sigil — the Village of the Cactuars gauntlet
Power up at the Macalania crystal

route.why: The cactuar gauntlet is a one-evening job

items.notes: Input GODHAND at the airship console.

items.name: Masamune (Auron)
steps: Rusty Sword — the Cavern of the Stolen Fayth's back path
Offer it at the statue on Mushroom Rock Road with the Mirror
Mars Crest — the end of the Mi'ihen Oldroad
Mars Sigil — unlock ten Monster Arena creations
Power up at the Macalania crystal

route.why: Ten arena creations is the real cost

items.notes: Offer the crest at the sealed statue.

items.name: Onion Knight (Lulu)
steps: Underwater chest at Baaj Temple (after Geosgaeno)
Venus Crest — the Farplane in Guadosalam
Venus Sigil — dodge 200 consecutive lightning bolts
Power up at the Macalania crystal

route.why: Two hundred bolts. Yes, two hundred.

items.notes: Lulu's doll.

items.name: Spirit Lance (Kimahri)
steps: Pray at the three Thunder Plains cactuar stones, then catch the ghost
Saturn Crest — Mt. Gagazet, past the prayer scene
Saturn Sigil — the Macalania butterfly hunts
Power up at the Macalania crystal

route.why: The butterfly hunts are short but unforgiving

items.notes: Kimahri's spear.

items.name: Kimahri's Ronso Rages
items.location: Lancet the right fiends across Spira
items.notes: Twelve Overdrives learned by Lancet: Jump, Seed Cannon, Self-Destruct, Thrust Kick, Stone Breath, Aqua Breath, Doom, Fire Breath, White Wind, Bad Breath, Mighty Guard, Nova. Thrust Kick has its own entry — it is the one on a clock.

items.name: Monster Arena

route.why: Buy capture weapons now — everything endgame routes through the arena

items.notes: Capture fiends across Spira to breed the originals. Funds, sigils, and the best training in the game.

items.name: Blitzball & the Reels
items.location: Luca stadium — anywhere via save spheres

route.why: The first tournament is scripted into the story — league prizes start here

steps: Attack Reels — tournament prize
Status Reels — league prize
Aurochs Reels — league prize once the other two are learned
items.notes: Wakka's overdrive Reels are league/tournament prizes; they also gate his Jupiter Sigil. Recruitable free agents rotate, so check contracts after story beats.

items.name: Airship passwords & coordinates
items.notes: GODHAND, VICTORIOUS, MURASA as passwords; Baaj and the Sanubia ruins via hidden coordinates. Free gear for typing.

items.name: Dark Aeons
items.notes: Valefor at Besaid, Ifrit at Bikanel, Ixion on the Thunder Plains, Shiva at Macalania, Bahamut at the Zanarkand Dome, Yojimbo in the cavern, Anima at Baaj, the Magus Sisters on Gagazet. Superboss tier — approach with a finished grid.

items.name: Penance
items.notes: Appears after every Dark Aeon falls. The true final exam.
